title: HtmlLegend
responsibility: Renders the native legend element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlLegend.attributes
inputs.description: Native legend attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlLegend.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native legend element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlLegend
outputs.description: The actual native legend element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
